title: 第6章 进化学说
novel_title: 御兽仙朝：我能设计进化形态
content_zh:
金教习的目光从王健身上收回来，扫了一圈底下那些或紧张、或茫然、或跃跃欲试的面孔，语气缓了些许。

    “知道为什么我要在你们领御兽之前，先来上这堂课吗？”

    没人答话。

    “因为等会你们去领御兽的时候，每个人拿到的，都是同一种兽。

    但同一种兽里头，个体和个体之间的差别，大了去了。”

    “选哪一只，怎么选，凭的是你的眼力。”

    “而眼力的根基，在你对御兽的理解上。”

    他没有继续往下讲。

    而是抬了抬下巴，朝讲台左边努了努嘴。

    “都看见了吧？这三只。”

    几百双眼睛刷地落在那三只灰鬃鼠身上。

    金教习抬手一指最左边那只体格最壮的。

    “这只，叫大铁。我养了两年。”

    大铁蹲在地上，鬃毛竖着，四肢一撑，挺胸抬头，一副天不怕地不怕的架势。

    金教习还没开口，肩上的【百问鹦】先嘎了一声，歪着脑袋朝底下喊了一句：

    “大铁是什么路线？什么路线？”

    底下有几个胆大的学生喊了一声：

    “力量路线！”

    【百问鹦】拍了拍翅膀，叫了一声“对喽！”

    金教习嘴角微微动了一下，没管那只鹦鹉，接着说。

    “大铁体格壮，骨架大，鬃毛粗硬，天生就比同窝的兄弟姐妹能吃能扛。

    这是身体素质决定的。”

    “如果不做任何引导，让它自然进化，它走的就是【铁须巨鼠】的公开路线，主攻力量和防御。

    这就是最基础的进化逻辑。

    身体素质决定进化起点。

    蒙学中都能学到的内容，我就不多说了。”

    他的手指向讲台下面的小【灰鬃鼠】。

    “出来”。

    那只瘦小的灰鬃鼠从桌腿底下探出脑袋，贼溜溜地左右看了看，然后以一种极快的速度蹿了出来。

    他并不走直线，绕了一个弧度就跳到了讲台的正中间。

    然后突然停下来，后腿一蹬，身体就窜到了讲台上，在砚台旁边蹲着。

    两只前爪抱着尾巴尖，歪着脑袋向下看，下面的几百人。

    下面有同学低声笑了。

    “这只，叫溜子。”

    金教习说这个名字的时候，语气里难得带了一丝无奈。

    和大铁同住。一个娘生的。”

    【百问鹦】又嘎了一声:

    “溜子什么路线？什么路线？”

    这次没有人回答了。

    因为看上去就不太像力量型路线。

    金教习也没有等学生回答。

    小溜子与大铁很不同。

    大铁抢食的时候往里冲，它向外跑。

    大铁跟其他的鼠崽子们打斗的时候，它就绕着墙根到处溜。

    它不会直接与任何事物产生冲突，总是采取侧翼、暗处、从别人不能看到的角落偷袭。”

    他顿了一下：

    “这是行为模式。”

    “同一窝生出来的崽子，吃一样的食，喝一样的水，可行为不一样。

    有的脾气很大，有的却很胆怯，有的喜欢和别人一起活动，有的则只身一人。

    日积月累，行为会在血脉里留下印记。

    印记很深的话，就有可能产生不同的进化分支。”

    他拍了两下掌。

    溜子似乎听到了信号，从讲台上跳了下来，落在地上的时候并没有发出什么声音。

    之后就再也没有了。

    并不是真的消失了。

    它贴在讲台上的影子之后，由于灰白色的毛皮和石砖颜色基本相同...

    再加上它故意放慢了呼吸，在那里一动不动。

    如果不仔细看的话，根本就发现不了。

    教室里面传来了阵阵低沉的惊叹声。

    “溜子如果进化，走的绝不会是【铁须巨鼠】那条路。”

    金教习笑着说：

    “它的行为已经偏离了灰鬃鼠正常的轨迹。

    长期“回避—潜伏—偷袭”的行为，会使它发展到“暗影”分支。”

    同种，同血，不同路。”

    “原因就是行为。”

    下面几百人鸦雀无声。

    金教习的目光落在了蜥蜴尾巴旁边的毛球上。

    教室里的人也跟着看过去。

    第三只【灰鬃鼠】。
content_en:
Jin Jiaoxi withdrew his gaze from Wang Jianjian, glanced around at the nervous, confused, or eager faces below, and softened his tone a little.

"Do you know why I want to take this class before you learn how to control the beasts?"

No one answered.

"Because when you go to get the beasts later, everyone will get the same kind of beast.

But within the same kind of beast, the differences between individuals are huge."

"Which one to choose and how to choose depends on your eyesight."

"And the foundation of your vision lies in your understanding of beast control."

He did not continue.

Instead, he raised his chin and pursed his lips toward the left side of the podium.

"Have you seen them all? These three."

Hundreds of pairs of eyes fell on the three gray-maned rats.

Jin Jiaoxi raised his hand and pointed at the strongest one on the far left.

"This one's name is Datie. I've been raising it for two years."

Datie squatted on the ground, his mane stood up, he stretched out his limbs, raised his chest and raised his head, showing that he was not afraid of anything.

Before Jin Jiaoxi could speak, the [Hundred Question Parrot] on his shoulder squawked first, tilted his head and shouted:

"What is the route of the railway? What route?"

A few bold students below shouted:

"Power line!"

[Bai Wen Parrot] flapped its wings and shouted "Yes!"

Jin Jiaoxi moved the corner of his mouth slightly, ignored the parrot, and continued.

"Big Iron has a strong body, a big frame, and a thick mane. He is naturally able to eat and carry better than his brothers and sisters in the same litter.

This is determined by physical fitness."

“If you don’t do any guidance and let it evolve naturally, it will follow the public path of the [Iron-bearded Giant Rat], focusing on strength and defense.

This is the most basic evolutionary logic.

Physical quality determines the starting point of evolution.

I won’t go into details about what you can learn in elementary school."

His hand pointed to the little [grey-maned rat] under the podium.

"come out".

The thin gray-maned rat poked its head out from under the table leg, looked around furtively, and then jumped out at an extremely fast speed.

He did not walk in a straight line, but made an arc and jumped to the middle of the podium.

Then he suddenly stopped, kicked off his hind legs, and rushed to the podium, squatting next to the inkstone.

He held the tip of his tail with his two front paws and tilted his head to look down at the hundreds of people below.

Some students below laughed softly.

"This one is called Liuzi."

When Jin Jiaoxi said this name, there was a rare hint of helplessness in his tone.

Living with Datie.A mother-in-law."

[Baiwen Parrot] quacked again:

"What's the route?What route?"

This time no one answered.

Because it doesn’t look like a power route.

Professor Jin did not wait for the students to answer.

Xiaoliuzi is very different from Datie.

When Big Iron rushes in to grab food, it runs outward.

When Big Iron fights with the other rats, he sneaks around the walls.

It will not directly conflict with anything, but will always attack from the flanks, in the dark, and from corners that others cannot see."

He paused:

"This is a pattern of behavior."

"Pups born in the same litter eat the same food and drink the same water, but they behave differently.

Some have great tempers, some are timid, some like to be active with others, and some are alone.

Over time, actions will leave a mark in the blood.

If the imprint is very deep, different evolutionary branches may emerge."

He clapped his hands twice.

Liuzi seemed to have heard the signal and jumped down from the podium, making no sound when he landed on the ground.

After that there was no more.

It's not really gone.

It sticks behind the shadow of the podium, since the gray-white fur and stone bricks are basically the same color...

In addition, it deliberately slowed down its breathing and remained motionless.

If you don't look carefully, you won't even notice it.

There were waves of low exclamations coming from the classroom.

"If Liuzi evolves, he will never take the path of [Iron-bearded Giant Rat]."

Jin Jiaoxi smiled and said:

"Its behavior has deviated from the normal trajectory of gray-maned rats.

Long-term "avoidance-lurking-sneak attack" behavior will cause it to develop into the "shadow" branch."

Same species, same blood, different paths."

“The reason is behavior."

Hundreds of people below were silent.

Professor Jin’s eyes fell on the fur ball next to the lizard’s tail.

People in the classroom also looked over.

The third [grey-maned rat].
